resources.string: Connections, API keys and extraction models
HTTPS API prefix. Include /v1 if your provider requires it. The app appends /chat/completions or /models.
Remove this connection and its saved key and models. Diary originals and analysis results are kept.
One connection can have multiple models. Fetch the list or enter a model ID and add it.
Send a fixed test message with this form’s connection and model. It may incur an API charge. No diary is sent or analysis saved.
Configuration saved. This model will be used for the next extraction.
Connection deleted. Choose and save a model to use it.
Cannot read AI configuration. Retry or check the app storage.
Cannot save AI configuration. Your form is kept; retry manually.
The saved API key cannot be decrypted. Enter the key again and save.
Choose a connection and model in AI settings, then return and extract this diary.
Check the connection name, HTTPS API prefix, API key and model ID.
The provider returned no models. You can add a model ID manually.
Model IDs added to this form. Choose one and save to use it.
Connection succeeded. Diary extraction quality still needs review.
The AI request failed or returned an invalid response. Check the configuration and retry manually.
Extraction cancelled. You can retry manually.
Extraction saved as an AI candidate. Review it before confirmation.
The extraction result could not be saved. The request may have been charged. Retry only when you choose to.
